messages:
Elena: FYI - spotted a negative adjustment on the Azure Marketplace invoice for ChannelEdge. Promo prorate appears to have applied twice for the Feb billing window. :eyes:

Elena: ```
INVOICE_ID: INV-20260228-CH-9921
PARTNER: ChannelEdge
SKU: azure.marketplace.redwood.standard
USAGE_UNITS: 12,345
CHARGE: $1,234.56
ADJUSTMENT: -$246.91
ADJ_REASON_CODE: promo_prorate_v2
NOTE: promo_prorate_v2 appears twice in charge pipeline
```

Ravi: ouch. do we know which rollout touched ChannelEdge?

Maya: we did a targeted pricing experiment (promo_prorate_v2) for 10% of channel partners starting 2026-02-15. ChannelEdge was in the cohort. Looks like the billing pipeline applied both the legacy prorate and the new promo logic for trial-day customers. :facepalm:

Connor: tagging Legal - are vendor clawbacks permitted under our marketplace agreements, or do we need partner consent before reversing an adjustment?

BillingBot: Adjustment queued: adj_id=ADJ-83472 status=processing (system)

Maya: net impact to Redwood revenue is $246.91 for this partner period. Two options: 1) issue a one-off credit and reverse the vendor clawback to make partner whole, or 2) honor the clawback and absorb the negative adjustment (we'd then mark this experiment as causing billing regressions).

Elena: partner has already flagged this with their channel manager, asking for fix + credit.

Ravi: precedent? last year we reversed a marketplace vendor claim for telemetry double-count - got signoff from Alicia.

Alicia: I need the evidence chain (logs showing double-apply) + estimated impact across partners before I sign off. Drop minimal forensic notes here.

Maya: plan: 1) RevOps will extract billing pipeline logs for 2026-02-14..2026-03-01 and grep for promo_prorate_v2 events, 2) dev infra will capture rollout toggle history, 3) Legal will confirm contract posture. ETA 24h. Grep sample below:

Maya: ```
# search billing events for promo_prorate_v2
grep -R "promo_prorate_v2" /var/logs/billing/2026-02-* | sed -n '1,50p'
# sample hit
2026-02-20T03:11:02Z invoice_pipeline: invoice_id=INV-20260228-CH-9921 event=apply_promo promo=promo_prorate_v2
2026-02-20T03:11:02Z invoice_pipeline: invoice_id=INV-20260228-CH-9921 event=apply_prorate promo=legacy_prorate
```

Connor: Legal: per contract we can issue discretionary credits; clawbacks initiated by marketplace vendors need evidence and partner notification. Recommend remediate + credit unless partner misreported.

Ravi: also check cohort size - if widespread we need rollback and JV notice to Azure ops.

Maya: cohort ~47 partners. Early scan shows 4 partners with small negative adjustments (<$500). ChannelEdge is largest. Will post summary.

Elena: Action: RevOps (Maya) to produce forensic snippet + cohort summary. Finance (Alicia) to approve one-off credit if evidence confirms double-apply. Legal (Connor) to confirm notification language. I'll tell ChannelEdge provisional timeline (24-48h). :pray:

Alicia: ok - drop the summary and I will review asap. Marking needs-approval.

BillingBot: adj_id=ADJ-83472 status=ready_for_review (system)

Elena: holding off on partner comms until Maya posts log extract.

Ravi: bump in 12h if no updates. :clock12:
